name: blueprint/manim-render
description: Math animation renders as a share pipeline: rh_run renders the scene, R2 stores the video, the presigned link ships it
recipe: render the scene (background + poll) -> exit 0 gates the put -> publish, index, share -> notify the link
pitfalls: manim renders are slow - background, never foreground
the scene source is the source of truth - keep it beside the render receipt
